'''Alexander Alexandrovich Maysuryan''' ({{langx|ru|link=no|Александр Александрович Майсурян}}; b. June 15, 1969<ref name="Струкова0">{{cite web|url=https://nlr.ru/domplekhanova/dep/artupload/dp/article/82/NA35463.pdf#page=47|title=Article clipping|website=nlr.ru|language=ru|access-date=29 May 2023}}</ref><ref name="rhga">{{cite web|url=http://www.russianway.rhga.ru/upload/main/%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B5%20%D0%B1%D0%B8%D0%BE%D0%B3%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%84%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B5%20%D1%81%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%BA%D0%B8%20%D1%83%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%BC%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%B5%D0%BC%D1%8B%D1%85%20%D0%B2%20%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%B8%D0%B8%20%D0%BB%D0%B8%D1%86.pdf#page=43|title=Article clipping|website=russianway.rhga.ru|language=ru|access-date=29 May 2023}}</ref> in Moscow)<ref name="a">{{cite web|url=https://forum-msk.org/author/7215769.html|title=Автор – Майсурян Александр|website=ФОРУМ.мск|accessdate=March 16, 2019|archive-date=June 25, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210625041106/https://forum-msk.org/author/7215769.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> is a Russian author and far-left political activist.<ref>[https://www.airo-xxi.ru/2009-12-27-19-12-47/doc_download/52--------- Kotonelets] airo-xxi.ru</ref><ref>[https://apnl.dnu.in.ua/5_2015/8.pdf#page=4 Актуальні проблеми вітчизняної юриспруденції № 5/2015] (in Ukrainian)</ref><ref name="tvc.ru">{{Cite web|url=https://www.tvc.ru/channel/brand/id/2494/show/description|title=ТВ Центр – Официальный сайт телекомпании}}</ref><ref name="rhga" />
He is a journalist, and the author of works on history and biology.<ref name="Струкова0" /><ref name="a" />

==Personal life and education==
He is of Armenian origin.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://maysuryan.livejournal.com/1187879.html|title=Программа "10.000 дней" выполняется!}}</ref>
Alexander Maysuryan is a distant relative of [[Alexander Atabekian]].<ref>[https://maysuryan.livejournal.com/300567.html https://maysuryan.livejournal.com/475247.html]</ref>
He studied at [[Moscow State University]]'s [[MSU Faculty of Biology|Faculty of Biology]]. In 1987—1989 he lived in [[Murmansk Oblast]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://maysuryan.livejournal.com/1312739.html?thread=49399267#t49399267|title=Зеркало для героя. Почему в советском кино не было инопланетных монстров?}}</ref> Now he is called a Moscow blogger.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mosmonitor.ru/blogs/History/den_vyishivanki|title=День вышиванки|date=May 17, 2019 }}</ref> [[Boris Stomakhin]] corresponded with him.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ipvnews.org/stomakhin/stomakhin_letters.pdf|title=Stomakhin letters|website=ipvnews.org|language=ru|access-date=29 May 2023}}</ref> Maysuryan is a [[Marxist]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://forum-msk.org/material/news/9850261.html|title=Социалисты Казахстана выразили протест против блокировки ФОРУМа.мск в Германии – Новости – ФОРУМ.мск}}</ref>
Aleksandr Kommari<!--Q131301228--> called him an "intelligent person".<ref>https://kommari.livejournal.com/3723282.html</ref>

==Career==
Alexander Maysuryan is a political journalist.<ref name="a" /><ref name="Струкова0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.vesti.ru/article/1282977|title=В Днепропетровске с аукциона продают дом Брежнева}}</ref>
He is a member of the [[Democratic Union (Russia)|Democratic Union]].<ref name="Струкова0" /><ref name="kavkaz-uzel.eu">{{Cite web|url=https://www.kavkaz-uzel.eu/articles/131457/|title = Автор сайта сепаратистов Чечни Новиков освобожден из психбольницы}}</ref> He also is a human rights activist,<ref name="kavkaz-uzel.eu"/><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nmc-lunc.ru/n14.htm |title=НМЦ им. Д.Р.Лунца |website=www.nmc-lunc.ru |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160730165231/http://nmc-lunc.ru/n14.htm |archive-date=2016-07-30}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sova-center.ru/misuse/news/persecution/2007/05/d10785/|title=Андрей Новиков подвергся принудительному лечению}}</ref> and a blogger (at [[LiveJournal]], listed in the Top 100 bloggers).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://graniru.org/Politics/Russia/Politzeki/m.238138.html|title = Грани.Ру: Дело крымских узников будет рассматривать военный суд}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ast-news.ru/node/ideya-pereimenovaniya-ulits-v-astrakhani-ne-ostavilo-lyudey-ravnodushnymi/|title=Идея переименования улиц в Астрахани не оставила людей равнодушными}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://gefter.ru/archive/23548|title=Сеть для революции: 1917 год в цифровом пространстве}}</ref>
Maysuryan starred in documentaries as a writer.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.tvc.ru/channel/brand/id/2580/show/description|title=ТВ Центр – Официальный сайт телекомпании}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.tvc.ru/channel/brand/id/2527/show/description|title=ТВ Центр – Официальный сайт телекомпании}}</ref><ref name="tvc.ru"/>
He is the editor of ''The Encyclopedia for Children'' (Аванта +, 1994).<ref>http://scjournal.ru/articles/issn_1997-292X_2017_2_58.pdf#page=2 {{Dead link|date=February 2022}}</ref>
He is the author of books including "Развитие в природе, культуре и истории : исслед. в форме диалогов" (Клуб XXI в., 2000, 384 p., {{ISBN|5-8237-0091-1}}).<ref name="a" />
He is a biographer of [[Lenin]] and [[Brezhnev]]. He worked in a museum for over ten years.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://maysuryan.livejournal.com/1186843.html?thread=40071451#t40071451|title = Новый памятник Ильичу}}</ref>
His articles are republished by the [[Russian Communist Workers' Party of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union]].<ref>https://xn--j1akbb.xn--p1acf/2025/09/16/%d0%bf%d1%80%d0%be-%d1%88%d0%be%d0%ba%d0%be%d0%bb%d0%b0%d0%b4-%d0%b8-%d1%84%d0%b0%d0%bb%d1%8c%d1%81%d0%b8%d1%84%d0%b8%d0%ba%d0%b0%d1%82-%d0%bf%d1%80%d0%b8%d0%bd%d1%86%d0%b0-%d0%b3%d0%b0%d1%80%d1%80/</ref>
